name: Butadiene extraction and on-purpose butadiene
principle: Butadiene is extracted from steam-cracker crude C4 with N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) solvent; on-purpose routes dehydrogenate n-butane (CATADIENE) or butenes. Lummus has licensed the BASF extraction process since 1990, with 38 plants over 4 Mtpa, recovering more than 99% of the butadiene at 99.7 wt% purity.

performance.basis: more than 99% of feed 1,3-butadiene; product 99.7 wt%

source.note: Lummus Technology, butadiene extraction technology sheet, 15 September 2020
